source_description: Follow-up mission for dedup-page-live-client-polish-01KT6ZCR. Live verification 2026-06-04 confirmed FR-008 broken in production: NavigationProvider's History.listen subscription is installed AFTER the inbound navigation event fires, so wasOnDedup is always true at subscribe time and the reset condition is permanently unreachable. Fix approach: replace the listener with belt-and-suspenders React lifecycle (reset on mount AND on unmount). Retire NavigationPort + SpicetifyNavigation + contract test + ADR-0004 (replaced by simpler lifecycle approach; new ADR-0005). Add production-lifecycle unit test. Bundle three non-blocking items: DRIFT-2 README NFR-007 styled-state-views note, RISK-5 README --dedup-topbar-offset override doc, SC-2 loading↔empty static-design disambiguation within C-003. Source brief: kitty-specs/dedup-page-live-client-polish-01KT6ZCR/mission-review.md DEFECT-1 + live-verification.2026-06-04.md §C.1.
